newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast crudes down with WTI, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast crudes down with WTI, trade thin.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crude prices continued falling in late trade with West Texas Intermediate (WTI) grade, while Alaska North Slope (ANS) differentials remained unchanged in a quiet market.
Traders cited heavy Canadian imports, poor refining economics, and early maintenance shutdowns for the lack of buying interest.
The diff for ANS stayed unchanged at $2.30 a barrel under December WTI, with trade limited to formula trade, a method of buying ANS off a long-term average rather than a spot discount to WTI.
